scope: One sourced epigraph for each of the ten content lessons. Welcome and the shared glossary are navigation/reference pages.
presentation: Native Markdown blockquote with Thai translation, source-language excerpt, author and direct source link; existing fonts and theme tokens; no assets or motion.
translation_credit: Thai translations for QuantCorner; the Thorp translation and parenthetical clarification were supplied by the owner. Source-language quotations are separately identified.
preservation: The separate pre-existing Thai opening remark in random-assets.md is preserved without inventing attribution.

quotes.author: Louis Bachelier
quotes.label: Théorie de la spéculation (1900), น. 21
quotes.note: Opening clause of the introduction, with an ellipsis marking the omitted continuation. Original French was inspected in the scanned paper.
quotes.relation: Many influences on asset prices; uncertainty motivates probabilistic models.

quotes.author: Richard Feynman
quotes.label: ข้อความบนกระดานของ Feynman · Caltech
quotes.note: Caltech reports the exact words on the blackboard left in his office in 1988. Used as an analogy about learning by construction, not a statement he made about the binomial model.
quotes.relation: Build the tree and replicating portfolio to understand option pricing.

quotes.author: Pierre-Simon Laplace
quotes.label: A Philosophical Essay on Probabilities, น. 196
quotes.note: English translation by F. W. Truscott and F. L. Emory, 1902. A clause excerpt; the ellipsis explicitly omits “at bottom”. The surrounding passage was checked in chapter XVIII. Thai translation is newly written by QuantCorner.
quotes.relation: Translate intuitive questions about future outcomes into probability densities and integrals.

quotes.author: Henri Poincaré
quotes.label: The Value of Science, บท I §V
quotes.note: Exact two sentences in the English translation in The Foundations of Science, translated by George Bruce Halsted. The word rôle and sentence boundaries are retained. This is a general mathematical reflection, not a quotation about Itô calculus specifically.
quotes.relation: Connect path intuition and rigorous limiting arguments when learning stochastic calculus.

quotes.author: Edward O. Thorp
quotes.label: The Tim Ferriss Show #596 (2022)
quotes.note: Verified exact sentence in the original interview transcript published May 28, 2022. The linked parenthetical Black-Scholes Model is an owner-requested editorial insertion, not part of Thorp’s original sentence. The Thai translation was supplied by the owner.
quotes.relation: Thorp describes his option-pricing advantage when CBOE opened in 1973, in a discussion of his earlier model and the publication of Black and Scholes’s work.

quotes.author: Harry Markowitz
quotes.label: Portfolio Selection: Efficient Diversification of Investments (1959), น. 3
quotes.note: Exact sentence visually checked on printed page 3 (PDF page 15) of the monograph scan hosted by the Cowles Foundation at Yale. Thai translation written for QuantCorner.
quotes.relation: A portfolio must be evaluated as an integrated whole, including relationships among its securities.

quotes.author: John W. Tukey
quotes.label: The Future of Data Analysis (1962), น. 13–14
quotes.note: Excerpt checked against the digitized original article, section 11, Facing uncertainty, across printed pages 13–14. Publisher PDF was unavailable to the retrieval tool; its DOI is the reader-facing citation. Trailing ellipsis omits the final relative clause. Thai translation written for QuantCorner. General advice about data analysis, not a remark specifically about portfolio optimization.
quotes.relation: A precise solver cannot compensate for an incorrectly formulated objective or question.

quotes.author: Fischer Black and Robert Litterman
quotes.label: Global Portfolio Optimization (1992), น. 34
quotes.note: Exact first numbered principle visually checked in the original article scan on printed page 34 (PDF page 7), Combining Investor Views with Market Equilibrium. Line-break hyphenation is joined. Thai translation written for QuantCorner.
quotes.relation: The model combines information from investor views and market equilibrium, with uncertainty in both.

quotes.author: Thomas S. Coleman
quotes.label: A Practical Guide to Risk Management (2011), opening epigraph
quotes.note: First 20 words of the opening epigraph, ending future opportunities, followed by an ellipsis. Verified in supplied complete book PDF physical page 6. Thai translation written for QuantCorner.
quotes.relation: Using past information to manage future risk, with limitations.

quotes.author: Benoit Mandelbrot
quotes.label: The Variation of Certain Speculative Prices (1963), p. 418
quotes.note: 22-word excerpt from Section VII, inspected in the original article scan, physical PDF page 26. Leading/trailing ellipses mark omitted text. Thai translation written for QuantCorner.
quotes.relation: Large and small changes tend to cluster in time regardless of sign.
